items.context: An email to an old friend

items.prompt: I'm so sorry I haven't been in touch ___ ages.

explanation.en: For is used with a length of time (for ages). Since needs a starting point and during is not used with the present perfect in this way.

items.prompt: It would be lovely to ___ up over a coffee soon.

explanation.en: Catch up means to talk and share news with someone you have not seen for a while.

items.prompt: My sister, ___ you met at my graduation, is getting married in June.

explanation.en: Whom is the object of met and refers to a person. Which is for things and whose shows possession.

items.prompt: She and Tom have always ___ really well, so nobody was surprised by the news.

explanation.en: Get on well with someone means to have a good relationship. Get by means to manage, and get off means to leave a vehicle.

items.prompt: I would be devastated if you ___ the wedding.

explanation.en: To miss an event is to not be there. Lost and failed do not take an event as an object in this sense.
